posts.name: Nielzabub
posts.cooked: Without word from the men on high, both are equally valid pronunciations. The letter in the name is an X, but he is also the tenth iteration which in Roman numerals is represented by X. Use whichever one you feel sounds better.

posts.name: Envisioner
posts.cooked: Technically, Omnitron-Ten is more accurate, since he is definitely the tenth iteration, so that's what the X in the name means.  However, pronouncing it as Ecks (not Sever) is my preference as well, in part because it reminds me of MegaMan X (who is named simply "X" in-setting), whom Omnitron-X would probably be flattered by the comparison to.  Plus I think letter X just sounds cooler.  I often abbreviate the name as Omnix though.
